title: October 16 Update: Rewards, Recovery and Co-op Fixes
description: Repeated challenge rewards, meteorite spawns, camping weather and The Ding receive changes in the first post-launch patch.
imageAlt: Sunset over the Over the Hill landscape

sections.heading: Pebbles & meteorites
paragraphs: Repeat objectives are worth revisiting, and meteorite searches need the current spawn positions.
bullets: Recovery missions and challenge trails pay Pebbles on repeat completions again. A bug had prevented subsequent payouts.
Meteorite spawn points were adjusted across every area. A location shown in an older screenshot may no longer match the current target.

sections.heading: Camping & co-op
paragraphs: The patch fixes two problems around camping and adds a way to keep your room code off a broadcast.
bullets: Weather speeds up correctly while camping.
A client taking a portal after camping in the same session no longer hits the reported infinite-loading case.
Streamer mode in HUD settings hides the room code in the lobby and pause menu.

sections.heading: Handling, display & achievements
paragraphs: Vehicle behaviour, camera collision and several release-build problems receive fixes.
bullets: The Ding has an adjusted center of mass.
The invisible-terrain issue on some older GPUs has a built-in fix. The earlier launch-option workaround is no longer required.
Several achievements that could not be unlocked by Next Fest Demo players have been fixed.

seo.title: Over The Hill October 16 Update - Rewards and Fixes
